summary: Closed the orch-gate session.js path for hookless background-worker claims. The audit-sprint changes (overlay.js arm-b, exec.js agentToolSpawn detection, daemon.js touchAgent fix, session.js /active-claim + /session-info hookless arms) were already committed to main in commits 137bbf3 and 34cf3e9 before this task ran. Verified all three mechanisms work end-to-end: (1) /overlay/status claim gate self-registers a hookless worker on claim when worktree is registered; (2) /active-claim returns claimed:true for the worker's own distinct session_id via the agent_tool_spawn+session arm; (3) /session-info returns is_subagent:true for the worker's own session so the gate denies the dispatcher trivial-edit allowance. Added 9 new tests to test/self-register-on-claim.test.js covering the session.js gate paths with a distinct WORKER_SID (the run_in_background case). Full suite: 175/176 pass (cursor-e2e-integration.test.js pre-existing failure unchanged). Also merged 2 recent main commits (bench/daemon.js autowire threshold env-override).

subject: Close orch-gate session.js path: accept hookless background-worker claims (+ land audit-sprint tree)
description:
The shell gate hooks/orch-gate.sh refuses legit run_in_background Agent-tool worker claims, blocking all dispatched inline edits (observed repeatedly 2026-06-15 on task "1"). This is the gap task 091a4bf1/20 did NOT close — see note note:note-mqfatdr2s67 for the full root cause.

Two-part fix, BOTH required:

(1) SESSION.JS PATH (the actual blocker). orch-gate.sh calls /active-claim + /session-info (routes/session.js), which have no worktree-backed hookless-worker fallback. A background worker registers its start_task claim under the PARENT session id (it inherits no SubagentStart, so knows only env CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID), but the gate is handed the worker's OWN distinct hook session id (SUB) and finds no claim. Fix options (pick one):
   - PREFERRED (= task /29): make start_task record the claim under the caller's REAL hook session id so /active-claim?session=SUB matches directly; OR
   - add a worktree-backed fallback to /active-claim + /session-info: if an in_progress task has a registered worktree whose claim's agent_id covers the target path, treat as a legit hookless worker (mirror the arm-(b)/worktree logic that already exists in routes/overlay.js:69-78).

(2) LAND THE EXISTING WORK. Task /20's touchAgent fix + its routes/overlay.js + routes/exec.js prerequisites live UNMERGED on branch orch/attempt/091a4bf1-...-20 (leased) and in the uncommitted audit-sprint working tree. Merge/commit that tree and restart the daemon so the live process actually runs the fix.

Acceptance: a run_in_background subagent that calls branch_task then start_task can perform a gated Edit inside its worktree without "no in-flight workers" denial, while a genuine main/dispatcher session is STILL refused. Add a test mirroring test/touch-agent.test.js but exercising the orch-gate.sh -> session.js path (not just the overlay path). Do NOT mark done until verified against a real background-spawn dispatch, not only a unit sim.
